newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on economic reform hopes.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on economic reform hopes.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Tuesday's settlement day amid speculative trade before an economic reforms expected to be announced by Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif on Thursday, dealers said.
Speculative and export-related firms' stocks rose sharply before the close after earlier setback pulled the index in the negative zone owing to selling pressure, one dealer said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index ended 10.31 points, or 0.65 percent, up at 1,588.47 amid 162 losers and 133 gainers in a turnover of 38 million shares, down from Monday's 49 million.
"It would be more appropriate to go long now and patiently wait for the relief package with selling limits planned in advance," dealer Zubair Elahi said.
ICI Pakistan rose 0.80 to 23.65 rupees, PTCL 0.50 to 30.25, Hub Power 0.35 to 37.60, Dewan Salman Fibre 1.15 to 39.90, Shell Pakistan 4.00 to 215 and Nishat Mills 1.35 to 27.15.
